text:
sam: Quick ask — looking for a 3-song 'pre-vibe' playlist to jog to before an evening walk, and a 4-ep micro-drama (feel-good or bittersweet). Bonus points for stuff under 40min/ep.
maya: Jog trio: 1) The Strokes - "Under Cover of Darkness" 2) Foals - "My Number" 3) Run The Jewels - "Legend Has It"
ravi: For micro-drama: 'Russian Doll' S1 is 8 eps tho. For actual 4-ep shows, else check Australian miniseries from ABC/Netflix collabs. I can DM specific titles.
elliot: If you want bittersweet and short, try the Japanese drama 'Erased' (12 eps) — not 4 but breezy.
zoe: my jog playlist is slower tempo but steady: 1) Vampire Weekend - "Hannah Hunt" 2) Tame Impala - "The Less I Know The Better" 3) The xx - "On Hold"
sam: loving the jog recs. tiny poll: react with :runner: for maya's punchy set, :heart: for zoe's steady set, :eyes: if you want me to just go outside and leave playlists behind.
maya: :runner:
zoe: :heart:
elliot: :eyes:
zoe: also rec cookbook pairing idea: if you're walking after cooking, hit a mellow three-song loop so you can rinse dishes in rhythm.
elliot: share link for maya's list: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3songjogexample
sam: thanks! will try Maya + a short micro-drama DM from ravi.
lunchbot: Lunch poll: who wants to swap lunchboxes Friday? :bento: (important office logistics)
